name: crew
description: The cmux crew layer: every Claude session's state on a board, ranked by who needs you, with plan rows, go chips and a sidebar. macOS and cmux only. Run `crew apply` once after installing.

jira_site.title: Jira site
jira_site.description: Your Jira host (yourco.atlassian.net). Set it to turn on Jira: board rows link ticket chips there, and crew doctor checks acli. Blank leaves Jira off.

github_issues.title: Link GitHub issues
github_issues.description: Link GitHub issue numbers on board rows.

observability_stack.title: Observability stack
observability_stack.description: The stack plans read for observability checks (read-only; keys come from your environment). none turns it off.

main_repo.title: Main repo
main_repo.description: The repo your worktrees come from. crew apply bakes it into crew-worktree and the other helpers as their default.
